historical_primary_reference: Submitted AAAI Table 1; original DrawerOpen-TD3 seeds 1-5
scope: Main-paper primary comparison only. No new supplementary-only ablations or reruns of seeds 1-5.
failure_policy: Stop queue on failed run, nonfinite recorded loss, configuration mismatch or incomplete evaluation grid. Preserve every attempt. No automatic production restart/resume and no outcome-based exclusions.
power_failure_policy: No reboot autostart. Audit partial runs before explicit restart authorization.
historical_provenance_limit: Original per-run full configs and dependency locks are not retained at the primary result paths. Preserve canonical TD3 source and launchers byte-for-byte, audit their effective settings, and recompute all 20 historical curves against the published seed table. This is not verification of bitwise historical environment identity.
statistics_note: Primary metric definitions are unchanged. Report historical 1-5, extension 6-10 and pooled 1-10 separately with paired 10000-resample percentile bootstrap. Confidence intervals are approximate, unadjusted and descriptive. No selective stopping for significance. Reaching 10 seeds does not guarantee an interval excluding zero.
timing_note: Record the current environment and five-worker concurrency; these runs are not a dedicated compute-matched timing experiment.
